title: aTyr Pharma Completes Enrollment in Global Pivotal Phase 3 - GlobeNewswire
description: aTyr Pharma has completed enrollment in its global Phase 3 study of efzofitimod for the treatment of pulmonary sarcoidosis, a rare lung disease. The study enrolled 268 patients, exceeding the target, and topline data are expected in Q3 2025.

title: aTyr Pharma to Present Preclinical Research Demonstrating Anti-Fibrotic Effects of ATYR0101 in Lung and Kidney Fibrosis at Keystone Symposia on Fibrosis
description: aTyr Pharma announced that it will present research on its tRNA synthetase candidate ATYR0101, which has shown anti-fibrotic effects in preclinical models of lung and kidney fibrosis. The findings suggest ATYR0101 has the potential to be a novel and differentiated anti-fibrotic therapeutic.
